title: Top 10 Defence Tech Startups in India to Watch [2026]
gist: Promotional forum post by Valiance Analytics listing ten Indian defence tech startups (itself first, plus ideaForge, Raphe mPhibr, NewSpace, Tonbo Imaging, Optimized Electrotech, Big Bang Boom Solutions, Sagar Defence, EyeROV, Garuda Aerospace) across AI, drones, imaging, counter-drone and maritime autonomy, framed by India's shift to indigenous defence innovation. No financial data.

insights.claim: India's defence technology ecosystem is shifting toward indigenous, locally developed solutions in AI, drones, robotics, intelligent surveillance and data intelligence.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Indigenization creates a domestic procurement tailwind for Indian defence-tech startups.
insights.quote: The growth of Defense Tech Startups in India reflects a wider shift towards indigenous innovation and advanced technology.

insights.claim: Indian unmanned-systems players include ideaForge (surveillance and reconnaissance UAVs), Raphe mPhibr (surveillance and logistics UAVs, drone swarms), NewSpace Research and Technologies (autonomous UAVs and intelligent swarms) and Garuda Aerospace (multi-industry drones).
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Maps the Indian drone and swarm landscape for defence exposure screening.

insights.claim: Big Bang Boom Solutions is developing counter-drone systems, electronic warfare, autonomous systems and intelligent surveillance for Indian defence forces.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Counter-drone and EW are growth niches as drone warfare proliferates.

insights.claim: In maritime autonomy, Sagar Defence Engineering builds unmanned surface and underwater vehicles and EyeROV builds remotely operated underwater vehicles for inspection and security.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Naval and underwater security is an emerging Indian defence-tech segment.

insights.claim: Tonbo Imaging and Optimized Electrotech supply electro-optical, thermal imaging, night vision and AI-enabled surveillance systems for defence and border monitoring in India.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Electro-optics suppliers are positioned for border-security demand.

insights.claim: Valiance Analytics' KM Intelligence platform offers multimodal document, image, audio and video analysis, knowledge graphs, engineering drawing analysis and sovereign, air-gapped deployment for high-security environments.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Sovereign/air-gapped AI deployment is a requirement for defence AI vendors.
